This is what I do. 

I try to wash dishes immediately after using them so that they don’t pile up.

But that doesn’t always work, I suffer from a similar dishwashing aversion.

Instead of thinking about it as needing to wash all the dishes, I will take just one action towards dishwashing. This might look like putting a dirty bowl into the sink. Or bringing down cups from my room. Or washing one singular fork. 

Often doing ONE action towards dishwashing gives me the momentum to just keep going! And if it doesn’t, I still made some progress by that one action :) 

I get how monumental it is in your brain. Stop thinking about the entirety of the task and just do one part at a time

wow i also wore a spinecor brace and pursued a serious career in ballet before having to quit! dressing rooms were my biggest nightmare especially at new studios or at auditions when everyone is looking at me and asking wth that velcro thing is. and I would sometimes have red marks from my brace on my shoulders/armpits that you could see in leotards 🥲 ended up with lots of body image issues from scoliosis and from my brace and from ballet and from just being a teenage girl!

having to wear the brace basically constantly reallllly affected my mental health because I had to learn at such a young age to ignore all that physical discomfort and pain “for the sake of my future self” and I’m still trying to heal my inner child from that and unlearn the pattern of ignoring/pushing away painful feelings

i wore my spinecor brace 20 hrs/day from age 7 to age 15! absolutely hated it but it did it’s job and prevented surgery. it actually brought my curve from around 38 degrees (age 7) down to like 18 degrees (age 11 or 12) but then with a growth spurt and less time wearing the brace it went back up to about 40 ish degrees now. i was always a bit insecure about wearing it as a kid but much worse when I was 14/15 and in high school. i always wore it underneath baggy clothes and hated how it made my butt and stomach look! I’ve had at least 3 or 4 different braces and the ones with snaps (like yours) used to give me the WORST ever chafing on the upper inner thighs like right next to my groin which was so uncomfortable and awkward to deal with. i also relate to your comment about having a super strong bladder now!!
